task.title: Create new terminal for each kanban action instead of reusing
task.description: When running a kanban action from the VSCode extension, it should create a brand new terminal instead of reusing the existing one. The previous terminal should be closed/disposed before creating the new one.
task.problem: When a new kanban action is triggered, the VSCode extension sends `claude "/kanban-{action} {id}"` to the existing terminal. If Claude is already running from a previous command, the word "claude" gets sent as input to the running Claude session instead of starting a fresh instance. This breaks the context-clearing design where each kanban action should run with a clean Claude context.
task.value: Each kanban action runs with a completely clean Claude context as designed. Commands execute correctly without interference from previous sessions, ensuring the context-isolation principle of the kanban workflow is maintained.
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given the user triggers a kanban action from the VSCode extension And a previous "Claude Kanban" terminal exists with a running Claude session When the action is executed Then the previous terminal is closed/disposed And a new terminal named "Claude Kanban" is created And the command is sent to the fresh terminal And Claude starts as a new instance with clean context
Given the user triggers a kanban action from the VSCode extension And no previous "Claude Kanban" terminal exists When the action is executed Then a new terminal named "Claude Kanban" is created And the command is sent to the new terminal
